$comment: Provenance of this native fork; scripts/native-fork-diff.mjs reads it. Update it with every upstream bump or delta change. The delta adds the lazy-hydration seed path (per-record keys indexed at open, one record read per cache miss behind a 64-row LRU), the optional `hydration` spec field, an async legacy-bootstrap fallback, and `KvTable.putMany`: a multi-record write that is ONE durable publish when the backend publishes the unit as one document (a `single`-layout unit's `putRecords`), with a per-record fallback that reports `batch-partial` when a mid-batch write fails. Every event, error, and write-chain behaviour is upstream.
